description: Demonstrate dynamic array operations: append a new element and then pop the last element, with label and index display.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MArray, MArrayStyle

class MArrayAppendPop(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        arr = (
            MArray([10, 20, 30], style=MArrayStyle.BLUE)
            .add_indexes()
            .add_label(Text("arr", font_size=28))
            .to_edge(LEFT)
        )
        self.play(Create(arr))
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(arr.animate.append(40))
        self.wait(0.3)
        self.play(arr.animate.pop())
        self.wait(0.3)
